guidance.quote: between 26%, 27% growth we should deliver now on a full year basis

guidance.statement: Target 60-62 million new loans in FY27; tracking well to delivery.
guidance.quote: deliver between 60 million to 62 million new loans in FY27

guidance.statement: Adding 18-20 million new customers to franchise during FY27.
guidance.quote: adding between 18 MM to 20 MM customers to the franchise in FY27

guidance.statement: Expanding to approximately 2,800 stand-alone gold loan branches by year-end.
guidance.quote: ending the year with close to 2,800 on stand-alone gold branches

guidance.quote: deliver a 25 to 40 basis point improvement in FY27 on opex-to-NTI

guidance.quote: likely to be one of the lowest years on credit costs

guidance.quote: 15% to 18% fee income growth is what I would just say to you

guidance.statement: Committed to 20-25% profit growth and 19-21% return on equity long-term.
guidance.quote: deliver the long-term 20% to 25% profit growth to investors in 19% to 21% return on equity

delivered.statement: AUM grew 26.5% to INR 5,84,624 crores with net addition of INR 38,000 crores in quarter.
PBT grew 29% to INR 8,537 crores; PAT grew 29% to INR 6,367 crores in Q2.
Booked 13.5 million new loans; added 4.5 million new customers in quarter.
Overall franchise reached 129 million customers; cross-sell franchise at 82 million customers.
ROA delivered 4.6%; ROE delivered 20.6% for the quarter.
Opex to total income improved to 33%; net NPA at 42 basis points.
Loan loss to average AUM improved to 1.56% from 1.88% year-over-year.
Recognized macroeconomic overlay of INR 337 crores; management overlay stock INR 512 crores total.
Cost of funds decreased 9 basis points sequentially to 7.31%; deposit book at 14%.
Gold loan AUM reached INR 24,000+ crores (4.1% of balance sheet); added 320 branches.
Total gold loan branches now 2,022; on track to 2,800 stand-alone branches by year-end.
Scaled AI unit to 328 people; deployed facial recognition in 534 stores and 1,163 branches.
AI bots handling 75% of DIY customer service volumes; disbursements increased 111% YoY.
Currently operating 130 agents and 65 agentic applications; tracking to 600 agents by year-end.
BHFL disbursements and AUM grew 25%; Sambhav loans crossed INR 500 crore monthly disbursement.
BHFL opex-to-NTI improved from 19.7% to 19.1%; PAT grew 18%; ROE improved to 12.7%.
BFSL PAT grew 36%; added 121,000 customers in the quarter.
Board approved INR 11,700 crores QIP and INR 5,800 crores preferential warrants by Bajaj Finserv.

themes: Secular growth across all business lines with 26.5% AUM expansion and consistent INR 38-39k crore quarterly net additions
Gold loan branch network expansion; 320 branches added in quarter; targeting 2,800 stand-alone branches
FINAI transformation accelerating with AI unit scaled to 328 people; 75% DIY automation; 600 agents target
Multi-layered credit provisioning approach: macro overlays, management overlays, LGD flooring, and customer leverage reduction mandate
Capital raise strategy focused on growth while maintaining medium-term ROA/ROE guidance and business model resilience
Proactive management of regulatory risks and gold loan product redesign to prevent customer delinquency
risks: Gold loan Stage 2 increase INR 1,047 crores from short-tenor schemes; INR 550 crores already resolved; monitoring delinquency impact
Monsoon/drought impact on rural portfolio; 87% LPA vs 120-year average; pruning in Maharashtra and affected districts underway
Regulatory uncertainty on insurance commission norms (discussion paper stage) and RBI revolver loan potential ban; testing alternatives
Customer leverage concentration remains elevated; 2PL/3PL at 7% origination (down from 14%); mandate to reduce to 3.5% in 6 months

analyst_pushback.question: Why not offer short-term gold loans given easier LTV with shorter interest accrual?
analyst_pushback.response: Short tenure creates cumbersome customer experience requiring frequent rollover; inadvertently pushes customers into delinquency

analyst_pushback.question: Should low-credit-cost two-wheeler customers be included in cross-sell franchise?
analyst_pushback.response: Yes, segment remains unchanged; maintain open architecture targeting 30-35% credit cost; pool likely to be low

analyst_pushback.question: What is driving MSME GNPA deterioration and are there other stress areas?
analyst_pushback.response: Pure mathematics from flat growth; 3MOB/6MOB/9MOB metrics better than 2019 levels; no blind spots identified

analyst_pushback.question: Why raise capital now when leverage is manageable; why not dilute BHFL over time instead?
analyst_pushback.response: Raise smaller relative to doubled balance sheet growth; capital gives BHFL transition time to repivot business model strategically

tone_evidence: Emphasizes 'strength and scalability' at 26.5% growth and delivers on guidance. Acknowledges 'VUCA world' requiring quarterly-derived approach; detailed on multi-layered risks including drought, regulation, leverage, and gold loan issues
